# KOL and smart-money tracking

**Read KOL and smart-money feeds and wallet labels without being fooled by bots, follow a few wallets responsibly, and write a daily digest.**

Reads Claudia's KOL, smart-money and signal feeds and the wallet labels on holders (kol, smart, whale, sniper, bundler, insider, fresh, dev, rat, bot, wash, exchange, pool, suspicious, top10) to separate signal from noise — tag combinations, size, repetition, timing and confluence — then profiles and follows a short list of wallets responsibly and writes a daily digest. Uses claudia feed, claudia holders --tag, claudia watch wallet, get_feed, get_trending with order kol or smart, get_holders, get_wallet and the SDK feeds, insights.wallet and stream.wallet. Use when someone asks "what are KOLs buying", "is smart money in this coin", "what does this wallet label mean", "should I follow this wallet", or wants a morning KOL digest. Research aid only, never copy-trading and never financial advice.

## How it works

1. Name the question
2. Pull the feed once
3. Read every row's tags first
4. Sort signal from noise
5. Check confluence, then one coin
6. Check who holds a coin, by label
7. Profile a wallet before following it
8. Follow a short list, quietly
9. Write the daily digest

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.
